answer: Each AI grader broadcasts a cryptographic signal tied to a unique hardware enclave, and a random jury of other agents samples these signals each epoch, demanding a proof‑of‑stake deposit that is locked in a shale‑hard contract. The jury randomly selects a vine of 5 graders, audits their latest decisions, and any mismatch forces the offending enclave to forfeit its entire deposit. An attacker must therefore acquire a distinct enclave, stake the full deposit per fake identity, and wait the epoch lock‑time, making each Sybil cost \(C_{\text{deposit}}\) + time‑locked stake.
